name: Spinning Slash

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Tryndamere dashes to the target location, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and generating 2 Fury per enemy hit, increased to 5 Fury against champions.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Tryndamere dashes to the target location, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and generating 2 Fury per enemy hit, increased to 5 Fury against champions.

parts.text: Critical strikes on-hit reduce Spinning Slash's current cooldown by 0.75 seconds, doubled to 1.5 seconds against champions.

mechanics.evidence: Critical strikes on-hit reduce Spinning Slash's current cooldown by 0.75 seconds, doubled to 1.5 seconds against champions.
Critical strikes on-hit reduce Spinning Slash's current cooldown by 0.75 seconds, doubled to 1.5 seconds against champions.

parts.text: Bloodlust and Undying Rage can be cast during the dash.

notes:
Spinning Slashs Fury generation stacks additively with Battle Fury's Fury generation on kill.
  - Killing an minion with Spinning Slash grants 12 Fury (2 Fury from enemy hit + 10 Fury from the kill).
  - Killing an champion with Spinning Slash grants 15 Fury (5 Fury from champion hit + 10 Fury from the kill).
There is no cooldown on Fury generation on kill with Spinning Slash.
Spinning Slash has no minimum dash range.

Flash will interrupt the dash but Spinning Slash will deal damage to enemies at the new location instantly.
  - Enemies already hit by Spinning Slash cannot be damaged more than once.

To ensure Spinning Slash deals damage when dashing away from an enemy champion, Tryndamere needs to move r-35 units towards the enemy beyond the distance he can basic attack at, where r represents the enemy's radius and 35 is the distance in units beyond Tryndamere's basic attack range that Spinning Slash can reach.
The cooldown reduction upon critically striking triggers on wards and jungle plants and even if the attack is blocked, but not if it misses due to blind.
: Cooldown reduction on critical strike interaction with parrying effects (dodge).

name: Battle Fury

parts.label: Innate
parts.text: Innate: Tryndamere generates 5 Fury on his basic attacks on-hit, and 10 Fury on critical strikes and each time he kills an enemy. After 8 seconds without dealing or taking damage, Tryndamere loses 5 Fury per second.

mechanics.evidence: Innate: Tryndamere generates 5 Fury on his basic attacks on-hit, and 10 Fury on critical strikes and each time he kills an enemy.
Innate: Tryndamere generates 5 Fury on his basic attacks on-hit, and 10 Fury on critical strikes and each time he kills an enemy.

notes:
Fury generation stacks additively: if the given action triggers multiple ways of generating Fury, all of them apply.
  - Killing an enemy with a basic attack basic attack generates 15 Fury (5 Fury from the basic attack + 10 Fury from the kill).
  - Killing an enemy with a critical strike generates 20 Fury (10 Fury from the critical strike + 10 Fury from the kill).
  - The Fury gain for killing an enemy also stacks with Spinning Slash Fury generation per enemy hit.
Attacks against structures will not grant bonus Fury, but will still reset the timer on Fury decay.
Attacks against wards behave like attacks on normal enemies, generating 5 Fury and resetting the decay timer. Attacks against wards can critically strike, generating 10 Fury.

Attacks against jungle plants will generate 5 Fury and reset the decay timer. Attacks can also critically strike, generating 10 Fury. Additionally, Honeyfruit drops restore 5 Fury for each pod collected and reset the decay timer.
  - Attacking an Honeyfruit and collecting the pods generates 30 Fury, or 35 Fury if the plant was hit by a critical strike.
Fury is only granted if the basic attack hits and will not be granted if Tryndamere cancels his attack windup.
Tryndamere will not generate Fury if the attack is dodged or misses due to blind.
Fury generation with parrying effects (block)
Sundered Sky Lightshield Strike will generate 10 Fury.

Effects that apply on-hit effects twice (e.g. Dusk and Dawn Spellblade and Guinsoo's Rageblade Phantom Hit) will always generate the same amount of Fury as their triggering attack.
  - If the triggering attack critically strikes, then the additional on-hit will also generate 10 Fury, if it doesn't, then the additional on-hit will generate 5 Fury.

name: Bloodlust

parts.label: Passive
parts.text: Passive: Tryndamere gains bonus attack damage based on his missing health, up to a maximum amount at 90% missing health.

leveling.label: Bonus Attack Damage per 1% missing health

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Tryndamere consumes all of his Fury to heal himself, increased for every point of Fury consumed.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Tryndamere consumes all of his Fury to heal himself, increased for every point of Fury consumed.

notes: Bloodlust can still be activated even if Tryndamere does not have any Fury.

Bloodlust can be activated at any point of Tryndamere's basic attack.
  - Note that if an basic attack will critically strike is determined when the attack windup starts.
    - This means that if Bloodlust is cast during Tryndamere's attack windup, the attack will use the critical strike chance given by the Fury before the Bloodlust cast.
    - Furthermore, the Fury for that basic attack will be given once the windup completes. This lets Tryndamere start building Fury immediately.

name: Undying Rage

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Tryndamere becomes enraged, instantly gaining Fury and a minimum health threshold for 5 seconds.
Undying Rage can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

notes: Undying Rage will prevent Overwhelm stacks from being consumed.

name: Mocking Shout

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Tryndamere reduces the bonus attack damage of nearby enemy champions for 4 seconds.
Tryndamere also applies a curse to all nearby enemy champions for 3.25 seconds. While accursed, they become slowed while facing away from Tryndamere.

mechanics.evidence: While accursed, they become slowed while facing away from Tryndamere.

parts.text: A nearby enemy champion is required to cast this ability. The target does not have to be visible to be targeted by this ability.

mechanics.evidence: The target does not have to be visible to be targeted by this ability.

notes: Regarding Mocking Shout applying the slow, facing away from Tryndamere means facing the same general direction (angle) as him; this direction bisects an 180 degree arc of a radius through him and his enemy. In other words, effectively, he must be "looking" at the enemy's back.
Mocking Shout very briefly reveals Tryndamere if he uses it while in the Fog of War to enemies.
Mocking Shout prevents Tryndamere from using Undying Rage during its cast time.

If the attack damage reduction would reduce the target's bonus attack damage below 0, the target's base attack damage value is unaffected, but their total attack damage will still be reduced. The target will however retain a bonus attack damage value of 0.
  - Effects that scale with total attack damage, such as basic attacks, will take the attack damage reduction into account for their calculations.
  - Those that have a ratio for base attack damage or bonus attack damage do not take the reduction into account.
Mocking Shout's attack damage reduction is worth −*20 to *80 per enemy hit.
